description: No periodic security updates are provided to workforce members about security threats, vulnerabilities, or changes to security policies and procedures. This signal indicates the absence of an ongoing security awareness communication program to keep workforce members informed about current security issues.
applicability: This signal applies to: Covered entities (healthcare providers, health plans, healthcare clearinghouses) Business associates handling ePHI Health information systems and EHR platforms Cloud service providers hosting ePHI IT infrastructure supporting healthcare operations

metadata.detection_notes: Detection of this signal typically involves: Review of security communication programs and schedules Examination of security bulletin and alert distribution mechanisms Analysis of security awareness campaign documentation Verification of periodic security reminder delivery records Assessment of workforce awareness of current security issues The presence of this signal indicates that workforce members may not be aware of emerging security threats or updated policies.

sources.title: 45 CFR Part 164 Subpart C - Administrative Safeguards
NIST SP 800-66 Rev 2 - Implementing the HIPAA Security Rule
